fields.summary_ko.0: Berkshire Hathaway (BRK-B) reached an all-time high of $596.92 on November 12, with a $10,000 investment one year ago now worth approximately $11,605.
fields.summary_ko.1: Under new CEO Greg Abel, BRK recorded its first net purchase in three years of approximately $2.35 billion and repurchased roughly $4.5 billion of its own shares.
fields.summary_ko.2: Over the past five years, BRK delivered a 108% return, significantly outperforming the S&P 500's 61% return.
